title: Detroit: Become Human
subtitle: Three lives in one city
summary: Detroit: Become Human is Quantic Dream's interactive drama for PlayStation 4, released on 25 May 2018. Its near-future Detroit is home to androids built to serve people, and the story follows three whose situations begin to change. Kara tries to protect a young girl, Connor investigates androids who have departed from their programming, and Markus becomes involved in a movement for freedom. Switching between them lets the player see the same society from different positions. Decisions made during their chapters determine which paths through the larger crisis remain possible.
body: Detroit: Become Human is Quantic Dream's interactive drama for PlayStation 4, released on 25 May 2018. Its near-future Detroit is home to androids built to serve people, and the story follows three whose situations begin to change. Kara tries to protect a young girl, Connor investigates androids who have departed from their programming, and Markus becomes involved in a movement for freedom. Switching between them lets the player see the same society from different positions. Decisions made during their chapters determine which paths through the larger crisis remain possible.

The player explores scenes, examines objects and chooses responses, often under pressure. What has been noticed can affect the options available when a conversation or confrontation reaches its decisive moment. Action sequences add timed inputs, and failure can send the story down another branch instead of simply demanding a restart. A character's survival is not guaranteed. The consequence makes attention to the immediate scene important even when its larger significance is unclear: a small observation may later supply the option that allows someone to escape a dangerous situation.

A flowchart shown after each chapter records the route taken and indicates other branches without revealing every event. It gives the player's decisions a visible structure and makes another attempt a deliberate investigation of alternatives. David Cage and Adam Williams wrote the story, drawing on the earlier Kara technology demonstration. Each protagonist has a different composer: Philip Sheppard for Kara, Nima Fakhrara for Connor and John Paesano for Markus. The Windows release followed in 2019, bringing the same branching adventure to another platform after its PlayStation 4 debut.
